description: Send a follow-up to CodeGene Support on a ticket you opened. The reply appears in the ticket conversation.

attachment_id.description: The attachmentId returned for this completed file upload.

expected_version.description: The ticket version you read. A changed ticket returns a conflict.

request_key.description: Make a unique key for this change. Keep the same key and arguments when retrying it.

text.description: The reply that the customer and CodeGene Support can read.

ticket.description: The ticket id returned by the support ticket list or submission.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: reply_to_support_ticket
title: Reply to your support ticket
